0022600171.text: The Clippers (1-5, 13th in the West and 4th in the Pacific, 3.5 games back) host the Raptors (3-3, 5th in the East) in the Clippers' seventh game of the season, with Los Angeles on a five-game losing streak, 1-1 at home and 0-4 on the road. Los Angeles is missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), and Derrick Jones Jr. is day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), while Jakob Poeltl is day-to-day with shoulder inflammation and a game-time decision, and the teams have not met yet this season, though the Clippers won the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 119-94 win in Los Angeles on March 25, 2026.
